localizedDescription: Version 0.1.3 build 19 separates normal code answers from local tool decisions, retains relevant conversation context, and requires supported explicitly requested reads before reporting their results. App-info replies show recorded capability statuses and source omissions without model relabeling. Runtime-tokenizer fitting preserves the current request and recorded evidence, failing explicitly when they cannot fit without replaying reads. Reasoning markers are filtered while preserving Markdown code. This unsigned SideStore preview retains build 18 restore handling and data identity. Pinned-model checks are limited fixtures, not general multi-model or physical-device acceptance. No broader autonomy, video downloading, vision or sync is added. Preserve existing app data and signing identity when updating.
